description: Adapted from docling (MIT) via the xberg test-document corpus (td/vendored/docling): three levels of nested tables keep their text in document order. Input html/files/table_06.html (see ../README.txt). Tika 4.2.0 (oracle, /tika/text) writes a tab BEFORE each cell, not after, and no title text in the body: the assertions follow its output.
